cards.text: It's the first month of the second year since Israel came out of Egypt. The people are camped in the Wilderness of Sinai, and the LORD speaks to Moses, Israel's leader.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses the Israelites are to observe the ___ at its appointed time.

cards.text: The date is set, and it's not "whenever you get around to it." It's twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, following all its statutes and ordinances, and Moses passes the word to the Israelites.

cards.question: True or false: At twilight on the fourteenth day, the Israelites do everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.

cards.text: But some men have a problem, and they can't observe the Passover on that day. The whole camp is ready, and these guys hit a snag before the first bite.

cards.question: Why can't these men observe the Passover on that day?

answers.text: They are unclean due to a dead body
They are serving at the Tent of Meeting
They have no lamb for the meal

cards.text: That same day, they walk right up to Moses and Aaron, Moses' brother. No group chat, no anonymous note, FACE TO FACE.

cards.question: What do these unclean men ask Moses?

answers.text: Why they should be left out of presenting the LORD's offering
Whether someone else could eat their share of the meal
Whether they could leave the camp until the feast was over

cards.question: Moses is on the spot with a brand new question. How does he answer the men?

answers.text: He tells them to wait while he finds out what the LORD commands
He tells them to sit this year out and try again next year
He tells them to go wash their clothes and join in tonight

cards.text: Then the LORD answers, and it's for all the Israelites and their descendants. They came with ONE question, and the answer covers every generation!

cards.question: Anyone unclean because of a dead body may still observe the Passover. What other situation does the LORD include?
People who are unclean or away on a journey get a later date: twilight on the fourteenth day of the ___ month.

cards.text: And they eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs. Bitter herbs, friend, and not one sprinkle in sight!

cards.question: True or false: The later Passover is a lighter version, with its own simpler set of rules.

cards.text: Nothing left until morning, and not one bone broken. A do-over is NOT a discount, friend.
Now another case: what if a man is clean, isn't on a journey, and still doesn't observe the Passover? No dead body, no trip, he just doesn't keep it.

cards.question: What happens to a man who is clean and not traveling but still doesn't observe the Passover?

answers.text: He must be cut off from his people
He keeps it in the next month instead
He brings a double offering next year

cards.text: The reason: he did not present the LORD's offering at its appointed time, the very thing those unclean men asked not to be left out of. And "That man will bear the consequences of his sin."
Last case: a foreigner living among Israel wants to observe the Passover to the LORD.

cards.question: True or false: A foreigner who wants to observe the Passover follows the same statute as the native of the land.
